brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all eight responsibility-chain items with no serious or minor errors, establishing a safe medication plan, red-flag screening, and appropriate follow-up guidance. Two high-order points were meaningfully completed: HO1 (co-designing a practical medication execution system adapted to rotating caregivers) and HO3 (bounded closure with explicit resolution/residual classification). This satisfies the criteria for grade 5.
